met_analysis:
The Low-Pressure area over southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhood persisted over same region at 1730 Hrs IST of today, 25th July, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extended upto 5.8 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height.
The Low Pressure Area over Northwest Bay of Bengal & adjoining West Bengal Coast lies over West Bengal Coast & adjoining Northwest Bay of Bengal at1730 Hrs IST of today, 25th July, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extended upto 9.4 km above mean sea level. It’s likely to meander over the same region and become more marked during next 2-3 days.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level continues to pass through centre of Low-pressure area over southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhood, Banasthali Vidyapeeth, Datia, Siddhi, Daltonganj, Jamshedpur and centre of Low pressure area over West Bengal Coast & adjoining Northwest Bay of Bengal & thence southeastwards towards Northeast Bay of Bengal and extended upto 1.5 km above mean sea level. The east-west shear zone embedded with cyclonic circulations associated with the above two Low Pressure areas roughly along 24°N Lat. across central India between 3.1 & 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 72°E to the north of Lat. 30°N persists.
